placementRules: Decorative props do not add collision or change exploration coordinates.
Ceiling silhouettes render above the tilemap but behind dialogue and cutscene UI.
Cyan light remains local to crystals, magicules and the forest threshold.
No source sheet or chroma background may be referenced by a runtime object.
The cave exit glow becomes prominent only after veldora_absorbed_exit_unlocked.
Environment overlays keep the central exploration routes and the Veldora seal center transparent.
Violet light is localized to Veldora's seal; cyan marks water, crystals and ambient magicules.
The awakening rune has no collider and remains behind Rimuru during gameplay and cutscenes.
